moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-fuzzy-text, written here): Text drawn to a canvas; each frame every 1 px row is offset horizontally by (rand − 0.5) × intensity × 30 px (±2.7 px at intensity 0.18 at rest, ±7.5 px at 0.5 for a hover beat), new seeded values every frame (seed = frame index, 60 fps). Demo: hover ramps 0.75–1.05 s (easeOutCubic), back 1.95–2.3 s, 66 px type; loop 3.2 s. SVG alternative: feTurbulence baseFrequency "0 0.9" + displacement scale 6, seed cycling 5 values per 0.1 s. Params: range (30 px) · intensity: nghỉ / nhấn (0.18 / 0.5) · fps (60) · seed. Every row of pixels is offset by a fresh seeded amount each frame (60 a second).
